summary: Backend: 22/22 pytest tests pass against EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL covering auth (login/me/register/duplicate/unauth), users, chats (idempotent create, self-rejection), messages (text+voice send/list, unauth), files aggregation (>=4 seeded non-text msgs), and calls (seeded + create). Frontend: login screen renders correctly with 'Welcome back.' + Fraunces heading + prefilled credentials + demo hint. CRITICAL BLOCKER: tapping 'Sign in' calls POST /api/auth/login (HTTP 200) but the app stays on /login and never navigates into the (tabs) stack — the entire app behind login is unreachable. Because of this all post-login UI items (chat list, +/radial menu, chat screen, send message, tabs, files/calls/you screens) could not be exercised.

ui_bugs.issue: After successful signIn, no navigation is triggered. login.tsx contains zero router references. The redirect logic only exists in app/index.tsx (which is unmounted once the user is already on /login), so the user remains stranded on /login despite a 200 from /api/auth/login and AuthContext.user being set. Confirmed via 3 API calls in a row, all 200, URL never leaves /login.

integration_issues.issue: Frontend integration broken end-to-end. Backend login works fine; the frontend just fails to react to the new auth state by navigating.

action_items: Fix navigation in /app/frontend/app/login.tsx: import useRouter from expo-router and after `await signIn(...)` / `await signUp(...)` call `router.replace('/')` (or `/(tabs)`) so the user actually leaves the login screen. Alternatively, add a `useEffect` watching `user` from useAuth() that redirects when `user` becomes truthy.

Re-run frontend playwright suite after fix to validate: home chat list (Leo/Noor/Sage), + tap opens new-message, long-press opens radial menu (radial-new-message/voice-memo/share-file/shared-space), chat row -> /chat/[id], shared-space-pill, send text message, tabs nav (tab-home/files/calls/you), Files Recent + Categories, Calls list + /call/[id], You screen with Ava + sign out.
Cosmetic: Expo logs warn about deprecated `shadow*` style props and missing Fraunces 600SemiBold font asset (one ttf 404). Not blocking but worth cleaning up post-MVP.
critical_code_review_comments: login.tsx is the only screen that initiates auth state changes but has no post-success navigation; relying on app/index.tsx to redirect doesn't help once the user is already on /login.
Backend allow_origins=['*'] together with allow_credentials=True is technically invalid per spec; harmless for this MVP (Bearer header, no cookies) but flag for hardening later.
MongoDB _id is consistently excluded across endpoints — good. password_hash is also stripped. JWT TTL of 7 days is acceptable for mobile MVP.

success_rate.frontend: Blocked at login navigation; only login screen render verified

seed_data_creation: None — relied on existing backend seed (4 demo users, 3 chats, mixed messages, 1 call). Pytest creates a few TEST_ users via /auth/register but no cleanup is performed (acceptable for MVP).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is solid (22/22). After main agent adds post-login redirect in login.tsx, retest the full frontend flow: login -> tabs -> home chat list (testID chat-row-<id>) -> + tap opens new-message screen -> back -> long-press + (mouse.down hold ~700ms) opens radial with 4 testIDs (radial-new-message/voice-memo/share-file/shared-space) -> tap chat row -> chat screen with shared-space-pill, message-input, send-button -> send a text -> bottom tabs tab-home/files/calls/you -> Files shows Recent+Categories -> Calls list with call icon -> You shows Ava Fields + sign out. Use viewport 375x667. EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is the public URL.
rca_of_issue: Reproduction: open https://connect-mvp.preview.emergentagent.com on mobile viewport, click Sign in. Network panel shows POST /api/auth/login -> 200 with token+user. AuthContext.signIn awaits api.post, then setToken+setUser. The login screen has no useEffect on `user` and no router.replace; index.tsx (which contains the redirect) is no longer mounted. So URL remains /login and the only rendered route is the login screen. Mitigation: add `const router = useRouter();` in login.tsx and call `router.replace('/')` immediately after `await signIn(...)` / `await signUp(...)` succeeds. A useEffect alternative: `useEffect(() => { if (user) router.replace('/'); }, [user]);`.
